title: S4-SAFE-04 — Offline and update promises need an actual network boundary.
goal: Work is kept locally: an edit saved with Save now is reported as saved to local storage and comes back exactly after a full reload, where a panel not opened before still loads and the history starts empty.

steps.visible: All changes saved to local storage
steps.why: The save is kept on this device, not sent over the network.
The saved edit comes back exactly.
A panel not opened before loads after the reload.

cliOnly: the same journey with the network actually disconnected, and update Restart saving first (tests/production/offlinePanels.spec.ts, tests/production/resourceCacheRecovery.spec.ts)
